### Local chat archive

Open **Settings → Features → Local chat archive** to see chats on this computer. Filter by CLI, project, inactivity or a date range. You can keep recent chats per project and protect pinned chats, active chats and chats with scheduled tasks. Preview matching sessions before confirming. Restore them in ChatGPT under **Settings → Archived chats**.

### Motion and workspace

- Switching between Board and Checklist now resizes the preview and the board settings together. Expand a session in the archive preview to see its details in place. Keyboard users and people who prefer reduced motion can move directly to the final state.
- Create an ordinary local Codex chat from a side chat up to a chosen reply. Clicking Palboo in the Dock brings a running workspace forward. Edge panels adapt to the active display.
- This version supports the CodexHost 0.23 renderer update and uses a static release manifest when checking for app updates.

### 本地聊天归档

打开「设置 → 功能 → 本地聊天归档」，可按 CLI、项目、未活动天数或日期区间筛选。每个项目可保留最近几条聊天，也可保护置顶、进行中或关联计划任务的聊天。确认前可逐条核对会话，归档后可在 ChatGPT 的「设置 → 已归档的聊天」中恢复。

### 动效与工作台

- 切换看板和清单时，预览与下方设置一起调整高度。在归档预览中展开一条聊天，详情会在原位出现。使用键盘或开启「减少动态效果」时，界面直接到位。
- 可从侧聊中选定一条回答，将截至该处的内容转为普通本地 Codex 聊天。点击 Dock 上的 Palboo 可直接唤起已运行的工作台。贴边面板根据当前显示器调整尺寸。
- 适配 CodexHost 0.23 的界面加载方式，应用更新使用静态版本清单。
